title: 50 Sea Turtle Grayt 30A Vacations
description_expanded: About50 Sea Turtle ~ 50 Sea Turtle Drive ~ Seagrove Beach FL 32459 Need a last-minute stay? Please call our office at 844-941-1213 to make last-minute bookings via telephone, as availability within the next 7-nights will not show on calendar. We do not allow online bookings within 7-nights/one week of an arrival date. 20% Discount off Spring Break and Spring Rates! 3-night minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed prior to May 22nd. Discount is reflected in online pricing. 50 Sea Turtle is a completely refurbished, family and pet friendly (dogs only) home located on a private, gated, Gulf-front street in Seagrove Beach. With 3,536 square feet of living (1,900 inside), 50 Sea Turtle accommodates up to 8 guests and offers 3 bedrooms, an open hallway bunk nook (the 4th "bedroom"), 2 1/2 baths, parking for up to 4 cars (2 under carport) and stunning Gulf views from most rooms. Private neighborhood beach with access just steps away. Maximum 2 dogs allowed; breed and weight must be disclosed at booking. Main Level: 1 Bedroom. 1 Bath. Powder Room. Kitchen. Dining Table seats up to 6. Kitchen island seats 2. Laundry Closet. Vaulted Living Room. Covered Porch with Gulf Views. #1 En-Suite Master King Bedroom, tub/shower. Second Level: 2 Bedrooms. Bunk Nook. 1 Bath. #2 Queen Bedroom #3 Open Hallway Bunk Nook (twin-over-twin, no privacy door - this is considered the 4th bedroom) #4 Queen Bedroom. Hallway Shared Bath, tub/shower Amenities: Business Features Wireless Internet (password secured) Entertainment Features 4 TV’s (Smart TV in living room) Distinctive Features Gated, Gulf-front street (no thru traffic) Private neighborhood beach access Pet friendly – max 2 dogs only; breed/weight must be disclosed at booking Hardwood floors throughout Vaulted living area Open hallway bunk nook considered 4th "bedroom" Bed, bath, and kitchen linens provided (no beach towels) Beach Gear Credit General Features Carport and open parking for 4 vehicles 1 King bed, 2 Queen beds, 1 bunk bed (twin-over-twin) 2 Full bathrooms, powder room, iron, ironing board, hair dryer, outdoor gas grill w/grill utensils, outdoor shower, outdoor porches with Gulf views, porch furniture. Linens and bath towels provided. No Smoking. Kitchen Features Fully equipped kitchen, island, drip coffee maker, brand new GE stainless appliances including glass top electric range, refrigerator with ice maker, microwave and dishwasher, toaster, washer, dryer. Area Features Timpoochee Trail (30A bike path) Grayton Beach (4 miles) Seaside (2.5 miles) State Parks (Tops’l, Grayton Beach, Deer Lake)
